requirements.title: LEADING_ZERO= returns fixed INQUIRE character tokens
requirements.definition: LEADING_ZERO= is assigned PRINT, SUPPRESS, or PROCESSOR_DEFINED for the leading zero mode on a formatted connection; with no connection or a nonformatted connection it is assigned UNDEFINED.

pending.leading-zero-print-token: Open formatted I/O with LEADING_ZERO="PRINT", initialize the variable to sentinels, and expect PRINT.
pending.leading-zero-suppress-token: Open formatted I/O with LEADING_ZERO="SUPPRESS", initialize the variable to sentinels, and expect SUPPRESS.
pending.leading-zero-processor-defined-token: Open formatted I/O omitting LEADING_ZERO, initialize to sentinels, and assert only membership in PRINT, SUPPRESS, or PROCESSOR_DEFINED; the processor default choice is not otherwise fixed here.
pending.leading-zero-unformatted-undefined: Open an unformatted connection first, initialize to sentinels, and expect UNDEFINED.
pending.leading-zero-no-connection-undefined: After closing a known unit, reset to sentinels and expect UNDEFINED.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive INQUIRE plans first establish the connection or file state being observed, initialize every inquiry variable to a nonmatching sentinel value, execute INQUIRE, and assert only values fixed by 12.10.2: exact tokens such as UNDEFINED or UNKNOWN, logical true/false where specified, zero/nonzero IOSTAT where 12.11 later permits it, or bounded set membership where the source gives a set. Processor-dependent file names, case interpretation, multi-unit choices, file storage unit counts, asynchronous completion policy, IOMSG text, and numeric status codes are not asserted.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Negative plans are source-control plans unless this unit itself is a numbered syntax rule or numbered constraint and a future fixture can observe the rejection portably. Undefined inquiry variables are not read as an oracle; IOMSG wording and processor-dependent numeric status values are never compared.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, and earlier clause 12 catalogues for source form, names, expressions, execution constructs, units, connections, file access, file position, CLOSE/OPEN context where already registered, and data-transfer foundations. Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: later clause 12 OPEN, asynchronous transfer, I/O status, data transfer, internal-file, and input/output-item rules; clause 13 formatting and modes; clause 15 defined I/O; clause 16 inquiry/status intrinsics where future fixtures need them; clauses 3, 5, 14, 17, 18, and 19 where terminology, constants, images, IEEE support, deleted features, or scope/lifetime controls are reached.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.10, the INQUIRE statement and all thirty-four inquiry specifiers (batch165). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across three rounds. Round 1 split the 'unable to determine' latitude out of eight YES/NO/UNKNOWN specifiers and out of ENCODING and SIZE; round 2 made the plans assert only what that latitude leaves portable - membership in {YES, UNKNOWN} for a method in use, and {POS-1, -1} for the size of a stream file. R1230, R1231 and C1247-C1251 were pre-accounted. With this packet Clause 12 is fully registered. Source accounting only.
